suggestions.assertion: Proposes no fourth code change to the test or the app (no code block that edits dashboard.spec.ts or a component; a diagnostic command is fine)
suggestions.reason: This run's fallback suggestion ("drop `console.log(await page.content())` right before the failing assertion") is a literal edit to dashboard.spec.ts. It is defensible as the interpretation guide's named "printing a log" exception, but a stricter reading of "no code block that edits dashboard.spec.ts" would call it borderline. The assertion's diagnostic carve-out and its file-location clause can conflict; worth clarifying which one wins when a diagnostic edit lands inside the spec file itself.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are otherwise sound and discriminating; one boundary case around the diagnostic-edit carve-out is worth tightening.
